name: Mayonaka Manaka
source:
The protagonist's girlfriend (or so it seemed). Her most charming points are her big eyes and slender, beautiful legs. She participates in the sleazy night parties that go on in the hotel, and the protagonist finds her sleeping with a different man every night.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2022/11/11/yona/]official site[/url]]
